current_state: Evaluated from a Cloudflare documentation link supplied by the operator. Not enabled on any zone. No ChittyOS artifact consumes the cf.waf.credential_check.* fields.
rationale: OVERRIDE of the computed disposition local-only, but NOT of its footprint. Unlike the secret-leak gate, admin-system(5) is honest here: enabling this detection is a zone-level configuration change, which the matrix's footprint 5 explicitly covers. The disposition is still wrong. local-only means the capability must execute locally — 'local filesystem, device state, metadata preservation'. An edge-evaluated WAF detection is the opposite of local: it runs in Cloudflare's network, not on a machine. The script reached local-only purely because footprint 5 routes there. Separately, and decisively, this is a documentation link with no artifact, no owner and no consumer, so the skill's insufficient-evidence rule gives hold regardless of footprint.
next_action: Re-audit as part of a deliberate zone-security decision. Relevant to the current credential-exposure incident, so worth surfacing to the operator, but enabling it is a privileged infra change requiring explicit authorization. Missing evidence: owner, target zones, consumer of the detection fields.
